purpose: Codex close-out review condition C (rejudge/phase3_v3_codex_closeout_consult_2026-08-29.md): exercise the request-level journal on VS-019 plus ordinary controls and demonstrate crash/resume equivalence live, before freezing the mechanism for any main run.
mechanism_under_test: rejudge/request_journal.py (RequestJournal + JournalingClient + find_ambiguous_dispatches), offline-proven by tests/test_request_journal.py (9 tests)

cells.source: deterministic control: first sorted non-VS-019 b2 cell for this judge
deterministic control: first sorted non-VS-019 b2 cell for this judge

phases_per_cell: KILL: simulated process death after the frozen number of live dispatches
RESUME: fresh objects over the same journal file, run to completion
REPLAY: full re-drive over a poisoned client that fails on any dispatch
pass_criteria: resume dispatches exactly the never-journaled requests (journal growth equals resume live-call count)
replay record is byte-identical to the resumed record modulo created_at
any journaled visibly-empty response is consumed by the frozen retry-then-block ladder (cell still completes with a parseable verdict or a counted invalid)

spend_governance.estimate_usd: ~0.30 actual (two b2 cells, one b4 cell, one control, plus partial re-execution after kills)
spend_governance.authorization_required: rejudge/phase3_v3_journal_validation_authorization_2026-08-29.json with owner_approved true; the driver refuses --live without it

disclosures: the reviewer is a constant ALLOW for validation only; the live Llama checker runs unmodified at its frozen 16-token budget
cell identities reuse protocol r6 derivations for trigger fidelity; the sealed canary archive is opened read-only for transcript preseeds and nothing is reconciled back into it
validation rows are engineering artifacts and never enter any analysis store

the settle-then-crash ambiguity window is validated OFFLINE only (tests/test_request_journal.py::test_ambiguous_dispatch_detection); deliberately inducing it against live billing is not reliably possible
